records.statement: BNY announced XRP and RLUSD custody support but disclosed no XRP or RLUSD assets under custody, customer balances or proprietary holdings.
BNY's XRPL-issued token support and direct RLUSD mint/redeem plans are future intentions subject to final BNY and regulatory approvals; they are not verified live capabilities.
The C2FO supply-chain-finance initiative is described as exploratory; no production issuance, investor allocation, receivables volume or settlement activity was disclosed.
Robinhood announced RLUSD use on XRPL for institutional settlement but disclosed no transaction counts, settlement value, unique counterparties, XRP bridge use or XRP inventory.
Ripple Prime financing and margin support across roughly 20 digital assets for Bitstamp is not accompanied by an asset list; XRP inclusion must not be inferred.
Coinbase Global Exchange availability and RLUSD collateral use were described as a later follow-on, not live launch functionality on October 28.
Coinbase's $22B average USDC held is a Q3 quarterly average, not a current balance. Company-reported USDC economics do not establish current Circle revenue or prove RLUSD displaced USDC.
Coinbase's RLUSD listing establishes distribution access but no RLUSD net inflow, XRP purchase, XRP bridge inventory or actual capital deployment.

PR #1400 is an append-only forecast/outcome ledger with concurrency protection, not a trained prediction model; walk-forward testing, calibration, drift detection, distributed locking and shadow evaluation remain unimplemented.

PR #1400 is four commits ahead and two behind current main, although the two main-side commits are timestamp-only changes to sentiment_shift.json and do not overlap its three changed paths. Fresh-main validation remains required before approval or merge.
PR #1401's artifact-only replacement does not preserve the current tracked-file/Pages refresh behavior; publication needs a separately reviewed read-only design.
PR #1402's push no-op path is tested, but manual workflow_dispatch approval, authorization and external side effects remain untested; zero-job root cause remains unknown.
The unsafe Databricks token-input workflow remains on main because PR #1398 is unmerged. Its proposed safe disablement passed branch CI/gate but is three commits behind current main.
At the 09:05Z inventory, 174 of 174 main-based open PRs had a base SHA older than current main; this creates a review and convergence burden but does not mean every PR conflicts.

Full repository CI was not run, dependency lockfiles were not found in the partial manifest inventory, and GitHub security-alert data were not accessible through the available read action. Vulnerability status remains unknown.
